description:
Did I take it? Open Maru and you know.

Maru reminds you to take your vitamins, supplements, and medicine, and one tap records what you took. Your records stay on your iPhone or iPad, and you need no account.

ONE LOOK
• Today shows what to take now and what you took already.
• A widget on your Home Screen shows your day.
• History shows months at a glance, and the last 7 days of each item.

ONE TAP
• Tap the circle beside an item to record it. When a reminder is for one item, tap "Taken" on the reminder and leave the app closed.
• Wrong tap? Undo it, or change the time.
• Not today? Tap "Skip", and Maru keeps that too.

REMINDERS AT YOUR TIMES
• Set reminders daily, every other day, every few days, or for days on and days off, such as 21 days on and 7 off. Record as-needed items without reminders.
• Turn on "Remind Again", and Maru sends up to 12 more reminders for a dose that you did not record.
• A reminder says what to take. One switch hides the names.

FOR SUPPLEMENTS AND MEDICINE
• "Scan Label": point the camera at the bottle, and your iPhone or iPad reads the name. No photo is saved or sent.
• You enter the name, the amount, and a note, such as "with food".
• Give an item a photo, and you know it at a glance.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
• No account and no ads.
• Your items and records stay on your iPhone or iPad.
• Optional usage statistics never include what you take, and one switch in Settings turns them off.
• "Export Records" makes a CSV file. "Back Up" and "Restore from Backup" move you to a new iPhone or iPad.
• Open source.

FREE
Maru is free, with no subscription, no ads, and no limit on items.

NO STREAKS
Forgot to record? Nothing happens. Maru has no streaks and no penalties.

Maru gives no medical advice. It is not an alarm: silent mode or a Focus can hold a reminder. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about what you take.
promotionalText: Did I take it? One look tells you. Maru reminds you at your times, and one tap records what you took. No account, and your records stay on your iPhone or iPad.
